title: One set of make targets for local runs and CI
when: Local commands and CI steps have drifted apart and the user wants CI to call the same make targets developers run, including image builds and releases.
prompt:
Goal: CI jobs that only call make targets, so make check on a laptop reproduces the CI result exactly.
Steps:
1. Contract targets, all .PHONY: deps (install from the lockfile), check (format check, lint, tests), build, image, release.
2. VERSION ?= $(shell git describe --tags --always --dirty) and IMAGE ?= app; every artifact name includes $(VERSION).
3. ENGINE ?= the container engine command, overridable per machine; image runs $(ENGINE) build --tag $(IMAGE):$(VERSION) --build-arg VERSION=$(VERSION) .
4. check fails fast with a non zero status and needs no network once deps has run.
5. CI steps shrink to checkout, setup runtime, make deps, make check; the release job runs make release VERSION=<the tag>.
6. Tool versions are pinned in one file read by make and CI.
7. ci-local runs the same sequence as the CI file so contributors can preview a run.
Quality bar:
- Any CI failure reproduces with one make command.
- No build logic lives only in CI YAML.
- Every target works on a clean clone.
Pitfalls:
- CI passing extra flags the Makefile lacks, so results differ.
- git describe failing in shallow checkouts; use fetch-depth: 0 in the release job.
- Targets needing a tool only one developer installed.
Verify:
- [ ] CI run steps call make targets only.
- [ ] VERSION comes from git and can be overridden.
- [ ] Contract targets are .PHONY.
- [ ] Actions in the CI file are pinned.
Output: Makefile, the CI workflow check.yml calling it, and a Commands table in README.md.

examples.input: o CI passa e local falha, quero os mesmos comandos nos dois
examples.output: Makefile with deps, check, build, image, release using VERSION from git describe; CI steps only call make deps and make check
